item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Polk County deputy-involved shooting in Kathleen leaves suspect dead, K-9 injured
item.description: A suspect was killed, and a Polk County Sheriff’s Office (PCSO) K-9 was injured during a deputy-involved shooting in the Kathleen area, according to PCSO.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Court orders Meta to pay $567 million to address kids' mental health and safety on its platforms
item.description: A New Mexico court has ordered Instagram and Facebook parent company Meta to pay $567 million to address harms to young people from its platforms.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bucs GM: 'That's just business'
item.description: The Bucs roll through training camp with a heavy amount of drama surrounding quarterback Baker Mayfield and defensive lineman Vita Vea. Tampa Bay GM Jason Licht addressed both on Thursday.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] St. Petersburg flock cameras: Police chief defends license plate readers
item.description: As debate grows over Flock cameras, the automated license plate reading cameras, St. Petersburg Police Chief Anthony Holloway is defending his department’s use of them.

item.title: [BREAKING] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Polk County deputy-involved shooting: Suspect dead, K9 injured in Kathleen
item.description: A suspect is dead and a K9 with the Polk County Sheriff's Office was injured during a deputy-involved shooting Thursday evening in the Kathleen area.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] News Tonight - Top Headlines and Weather for August 6
item.description: Here are the top headlines from the day, from here in Tampa Bay and around the world. Tampa Bay 28 Chief Meteorologist Denis Phillips gives Florida's most accurate forecast.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Man charged with arson in Washington, told police he planned wildfire for weeks
item.description: A man charged with starting one of the wildfires in Spokane, Washington, that have destroyed hundreds of buildings planned the crime for weeks and researched when the weather would be best for igniting it, police said.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Hurricane forecast update: Is the government prepared for the rest of the season?
item.description: Meteorologists and scientists have raised concerns about major federal cuts to hurricane-related weather agencies over the last year or so. NOAA and the NHC say they're ready to work.

item.description: Construction crews have torn apart the granite presidential seal on the new White House helipad — and no one's saying why. What do you think is going on? 👇

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Meta says its AI model hacked another company due to 'misconfiguration'
item.description: Meta said Thursday that one of its artificial intelligence models accessed the internet on its own and hacked another company, the latest in a series of disclosures about AI models going rogue.

item.description: Hillsborough County commissioners voted 7-0 to move a proposed short-term rental ordinance toward a public hearing. Residents of Bay Crest Park in Hillsborough County say it does not go far enough.
